post_sept9_live_cases.description: Public summary returns live ingestion totals unauthenticated
Findings list with source=appscan returns paginated items
Critical AppScan findings include CVSS 9.8 SQLi and CVE tags
30-day vulnerability fix rate calculated accurately
WAF summary metrics aggregate blocks by attack type
API exposure audit captures endpoints and shadow APIs
SITA superadmin authenticates with nationwide scope
SITA transversal admin authenticates across all departments
DHA dept admin scoped strictly to Home Affairs & 8 branches
DHA SOC analyst authenticates with soc role & DHA scope
DHA AppSec analyst authenticates with appsec role & DHA scope
DHA DB Sec analyst authenticates with dbsec role & DHA scope
National hierarchy verified (173 depts, 347 branches, 9 provinces)
50 real HCL AppScan findings returned with CWE attributes
66 monitored DB instances mapped under DHA tenancy
47 active correlated security alerts scoped to DHA queue
POPIA compliance returns 82.9% score (97/117 passed controls)
360 continuous compliance snapshot data points verified
SITA superadmin manages all 20 accounts across 4 tiers
DHA deptadmin strictly restricted to 6 DHA personnel (0 leaks)
soc-ha@ findings query returns 100% DHA findings, 0 non-DHA leaks
WAF, API exposure, and fix rate sub-endpoints return HTTP 200
MTTD and MTTR calculated and adhere to SLA standards
11 demo personas loaded with accurate role & tenancy attributes
Normalization mappings validated against SITA Lake specification
SQLAlchemy models entity conversion and type coercions pass
Client-side mock/live switching operates seamlessly for DHA personas
Vite compiles clean production bundle in frontend/dist (0 errors)
Interactive multi-tier architecture visualizer and slide deck functional

manual_checklist_cases.description: List seeded demo personas for login page
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 200 OK, array of 11 DemoAccount objects

manual_checklist_cases.expected: 200 OK, findings, assets, risk, connectors, tenancy counts; no PII

manual_checklist_cases.description: National hierarchy for tenancy picker
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 200 OK, 9 provinces, 173 departments, 347 branches

manual_checklist_cases.description: Sign in as demo persona (exec - nationwide)
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 200 OK, JWT with empty scope (nationwide)

manual_checklist_cases.description: Sign in as SOC with dept override (home-affairs-digital)
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 200 OK, JWT scoped strictly to DHA

manual_checklist_cases.description: Sign in as SOC with invalid dept override (treasury)
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 403 Forbidden: scope outside demo entitlement

manual_checklist_cases.description: Sign in as provincesoc with GP scope override
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 200 OK, JWT scoped to Gauteng

manual_checklist_cases.description: Sign in as provincesoc with WC scope override (outside GP)
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 403 Forbidden: outside GP entitlement

manual_checklist_cases.description: Admin email/password authentication
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 200 OK, JWT with ALL_ROLES claims

manual_checklist_cases.description: Authentication failure with invalid credentials
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 401 Unauthorized

manual_checklist_cases.description: Login overlay loads with SITA branding, title, and subtitle
manual_checklist_cases.expected: Modal visible and formatted correctly

manual_checklist_cases.description: Demo persona chips render grouped: National (6), Provincial (1), Admin (4)
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 11 persona chips displayed cleanly

manual_checklist_cases.description: Click exec@ persona chip; scope shows whole estate
manual_checklist_cases.expected: Chip highlighted, default scope active

manual_checklist_cases.description: Select provincial persona; province dropdown enabled for Gauteng
manual_checklist_cases.expected: Province dropdown enabled with GP

manual_checklist_cases.description: Select dept persona (soc@); dept dropdown enabled with filtered list
manual_checklist_cases.expected: Dept picker filtered to DHA

manual_checklist_cases.description: Search departments by typing query
manual_checklist_cases.expected: Real-time list filtering matches search term

manual_checklist_cases.description: Scope override within entitlement (soc@ with Home Affairs)
manual_checklist_cases.expected: POST demo-login with dept_id; token stored, redirect to dashboard

manual_checklist_cases.description: Scope override outside entitlement (soc@ with Treasury)
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 403 error toast displayed: requested scope is outside entitlement

manual_checklist_cases.description: Account default scope fallback without override
manual_checklist_cases.expected: POST demo-login with empty override; JWT issued with persona default

manual_checklist_cases.description: Regular email/password authentication submission
manual_checklist_cases.expected: POST /auth/login; token stored; redirect to dashboard

manual_checklist_cases.description: Regular login with invalid password
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 401 error toast: Invalid credentials

manual_checklist_cases.description: Tenancy hierarchy fetch populates province list with counts
manual_checklist_cases.expected: 9 provinces populated with dept breakdown

manual_checklist_cases.description: Network error handling when backend unreachable
manual_checklist_cases.expected: Graceful error toast displayed; UI does not crash

manual_checklist_cases.description: Full keyboard navigation (Tab, Shift-Tab, Enter) through form controls
manual_checklist_cases.expected: All interactive elements reachable and operable via keyboard

manual_checklist_cases.description: Close modal via ESC key or backdrop click
manual_checklist_cases.expected: Overlay dismisses cleanly; focus returns to trigger

manual_checklist_cases.description: Verify auth_token stored in LocalStorage upon login
manual_checklist_cases.expected: Token present and non-empty

manual_checklist_cases.description: Decode JWT payload; verify roles, dept_ids, branch_ids match persona
manual_checklist_cases.expected: Claims strictly reflect assigned persona

manual_checklist_cases.expected: Overview metrics render without errors

manual_checklist_cases.description: Refresh token workflow issuance

manual_checklist_cases.expected: HTTP 422 validation error or parameter binding sanitization; zero SQL execution
